body:
Map.TickAll() returned every region unconditionally each minute, causing a broadcast per region even with zero ownership changes. Now only changed regions are returned/broadcast. New regression test, go test green, gfd-mud.service rebuilt+restarted live. Commit GoblinFoxDragon 59fabdf.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-79: fix conquest broadcast spam in gfd-mud
